description: Versioned, title-only sub-role taxonomy for the Data & Analytics role family. It narrows the existing role-family-v1 result; it never changes which listings belong to the family. Ambiguous or multiple-role titles remain explicitly uncertain and are not forced into one sub-role.
scope: Applied only when the deterministic role-family classifier returns Data & Analytics. Titles outside that family keep no sub-role, even when a pattern below would match, so this taxonomy cannot silently shift the existing family metric or its historical snapshots.
uncertainReasonMultiple: Multiple sub-role signals were found, so no single label is forced.
uncertainReasonNone: This title belongs to the Data & Analytics family but matches no specific sub-role definition; it stays unspecified rather than being forced.

roles.label: Data & Analytics Leadership
roles.definition: A leadership or people-management role over data, analytics, insights or business-intelligence work. A 'Lead' seniority word alone does not qualify; the title must pair a leadership word with a data/analytics function, or name a data leadership post.

roles.label: Data Analyst
roles.definition: A role whose primary work is analysing, interpreting or reporting data (including insights and reporting analysts).

roles.label: BI Analyst/Developer
roles.definition: A business-intelligence or BI-platform role: BI analyst/developer/specialist, business-intelligence analyst/developer, or a named BI platform role such as Power BI or Tableau.

roles.label: Analytics Engineer
roles.definition: A role that engineers analytics data models and transformations, explicitly titled analytics engineer or analytics engineering.

roles.label: Data Engineer
roles.definition: A role that builds or operates data pipelines, platforms, warehouses or ETL, explicitly titled data engineer/engineering or equivalent.

roles.label: Data Scientist
roles.definition: A role explicitly titled data scientist/data science, or a machine-learning/deep-learning engineer, scientist or specialist. A bare AI context phrase is not enough.
